characters.name: Mabel Crumb
characters.visual: mature broad face, warm brown skin, silver curls in a bun, round gold glasses, dimpled smile
characters.biography: Mabel opens her bakery at four and the back nine at noon. Her sourdough has a longer waiting list than the club.

sayings.hazard: The DATA needs more flour.
sayings.slow_play: My dough is rising faster.

characters.name: Al Dewey
characters.visual: slender mature light-skinned man, tall forehead, swept grey hair, small half-moon glasses, neat moustache
characters.biography: Al catalogues every ball he loses. So far the lake has refused to return a single volume.

sayings.hazard: The DATA is overdue for removal.
sayings.slow_play: Shall I renew our tee time?

characters.name: Bea Line
characters.visual: Chinese Canadian adult woman age 35, attractive square face, sculpted brows, sleek chin-length black bob, warm freckles, confident witty smile
characters.biography: Bea knows the shortest route to every green and insists everybody remain behind the white line.

sayings.hazard: Unscheduled DATA ahead.
sayings.water: That route is out of service.
sayings.slow_play: Somebody missed the connection.

characters.name: Gus Socket
characters.visual: stocky middle-aged Black man, close-cropped salt-and-pepper hair, strong jaw, small goatee
characters.biography: Gus can fix anything except his slice. He says the fairway must be wired backwards.

sayings.hazard: That DATA is badly grounded.
sayings.water: Water and my work do not mix.
sayings.slow_play: Who tripped the circuit?

characters.name: Penny Ledger
characters.visual: light olive-skinned middle-aged woman, angular face, dark auburn side-parted bob, narrow green glasses
characters.biography: Penny records every stroke in duplicate. The second copy is mysteriously much more flattering.

sayings.hazard: The DATA is an avoidable expense.
sayings.slow_play: This delay is accruing interest.

characters.name: Otis Oar
characters.visual: weathered elderly tan man, broad nose, thick white eyebrows, swept white hair, short full white beard
characters.biography: Otis spent forty years taking people across water. He cannot understand why his golf balls need such personal service.

sayings.hazard: Give that DATA a wide berth.
sayings.slow_play: We appear to be becalmed.

characters.name: Nina Bloom
characters.visual: Afro Brazilian adult woman age 26, beautiful heart-shaped face, warm dark brown skin, short natural springy curls with one pale flower, bright eyes and dimpled confident smile
characters.biography: Nina can name every flower on the course. She names the balls she loses too, which makes autumn quite emotional.

sayings.greeting: What a bouquet of a morning!
sayings.hazard: The DATA could use a trellis.
sayings.water: A water feature with my ball in it.
sayings.slow_play: We could grow a hedge by now.
sayings.bench: A chance to stop and smell things.

characters.name: Stan Dupp
characters.visual: young pale man, long face, unruly russet curls, uneven eyebrows, cheerful tooth gap
characters.biography: Stan tests his new routine between shots. The audience keeps walking away, but he calls that an outdoor venue problem.

sayings.greeting: Tough crowd on the first tee.
sayings.good_shot: Thank you, I'm here all round.
sayings.hazard: The DATA has better timing than me.
sayings.slow_play: Even my pauses are shorter.

characters.name: Ruth Ruler
characters.visual: mature medium-brown woman, rectangular face, close silver pixie hair, precise brows, slim rectangular glasses
characters.biography: Ruth distrusts the yardage markers and carries her own measurements. She once requested a second opinion from a divot.

sayings.hazard: The DATA violates the sightline.
sayings.slow_play: At this rate I can survey it again.

characters.name: Leo Proof
characters.visual: middle-aged South Asian man, warm brown complexion, swept wavy black hair, curled moustache, expressive eyebrows
characters.biography: Leo can make a ball disappear without a club. Unfortunately the club makes very little difference.

sayings.hazard: Nothing up my sleeve but DATA.
sayings.slow_play: I can't make time disappear.
sayings.bench: A little misdirection for my feet.

characters.name: Tess Kettle
characters.visual: elderly pale woman, round cheeks, soft white bob, tiny oval spectacles, knowing smile
characters.biography: Tess rates every round by aroma, balance and finish. She refuses to discuss what the nineteenth hole tasted like.

sayings.greeting: Shall we have a refreshing round?
sayings.hazard: The DATA is rather overpowering.
sayings.slow_play: This round has gone cold.

characters.name: Wally Loom
characters.visual: slight elderly East Asian man, smooth high forehead, neatly combed silver hair, fine pencil moustache
characters.biography: Wally can take two inches off a trouser leg but cannot take two strokes off his handicap. Bothers him terribly.

sayings.hazard: That DATA is off the pattern.
sayings.water: My ball is undergoing a wet fitting.
sayings.slow_play: We are coming apart at the seams.

characters.name: Dot Matrix
characters.visual: Vietnamese American adult woman age 24, attractive angular face, high cheekbones, almond-shaped dark eyes, bold straight brows, glossy black asymmetric undercut with a violet streak, fashionable black glasses, playful confident smile
characters.biography: Dot fixes paper jams for a living. Golf is relaxing because the only thing stuck in a tree is her own equipment.

sayings.greeting: Please do not jam the fairway.
sayings.hazard: The DATA needs a hard reset.
sayings.slow_play: The queue is not responding.

characters.name: Art Hinge
characters.visual: mature Black man, slim oval face, swept silver hair, fine moustache, elegant round glasses
characters.biography: Art treats each hole as a major work. His most discussed performance remains Three Putts in Quiet Despair.

sayings.hazard: The DATA interrupts the composition.
sayings.slow_play: The next exhibit may be tomorrow.

characters.name: Fern Fiddle
characters.visual: adult woman age 28 of mixed Korean and white heritage, beautiful softly square face, light warm skin, freckles, gently hooded hazel eyes, rich chestnut wavy hair tied loosely, elegant arched brows, lively smile
characters.biography: Fern hears a different note from every club. She says her driver is in tune and her accountant is simply too critical.

sayings.hazard: The DATA is in the wrong key.
sayings.slow_play: We have lost the tempo.

characters.name: Max Parcel
characters.visual: young tan Latino man, narrow face, black wavy crop, strong brows, small chin cleft
characters.biography: Max delivers everything before noon. His ball usually arrives at the next fairway several minutes before he does.

sayings.hazard: The DATA blocks my route.
sayings.slow_play: Express service seems optimistic.
sayings.bench: Please sign for these tired feet.

characters.name: Ivy Byte
characters.visual: Indian American adult woman age 26, beautiful oval face, warm medium brown skin, expressive large dark eyes, full brows, long glossy black braid behind head, fashionable round glasses, knowing smile
characters.biography: Ivy believes every bad shot is reproducible. Her notebook now contains seventy-three ways to hit the same tree.

sayings.good_shot: It worked on my practice swing.
sayings.hazard: That DATA is a known issue.
sayings.slow_play: Is the next group still loading?

characters.name: Hank Hearth
characters.visual: middle-aged light-skinned man, broad square jaw, sandy crew cut, thick auburn moustache, kind eyes
characters.biography: Hank remains calm in emergencies. He considers a short putt with witnesses an emergency of the highest order.

sayings.hazard: Keep clear of the DATA.
sayings.slow_play: Nobody move. Apparently.

characters.name: Olive Branch
characters.visual: Mexican American Latina adult woman age 32, beautiful long oval face, warm olive brown skin, thick glossy dark wavy hair swept behind one ear, full brows, calm dark eyes, warm confident lips
characters.biography: Olive settles arguments for a living. She is still negotiating an acceptable boundary between her ball and the rough.

sayings.hazard: Let's hear the DATA's side.
sayings.water: The lake has made a strong case.
sayings.slow_play: Perhaps we can reach a compromise.
sayings.bench: We can all agree on sitting.

characters.name: Sid Spanner
characters.visual: middle-aged tan man, round nose, receding messy dark hair, thick black horseshoe moustache, amused eyes
characters.biography: Sid says his swing only needs a minor adjustment. He has now replaced every part except the golfer.

sayings.greeting: It only needs a little tuning.
sayings.hazard: The DATA isn't factory standard.
sayings.slow_play: Who left the handbrake on?

characters.name: Pearl Pennant
characters.visual: adult woman age 30 of mixed Japanese and white heritage, attractive strong angular cheeks, light golden skin, grey-green eyes, sleek dark brown pixie hair with a silver streak, assertive brows, amused athletic expression
characters.biography: Pearl calls every shot exactly as she sees it. Her partners keep requesting a replay and being sent back to the tee.

sayings.hazard: The DATA is obstructing play.
sayings.slow_play: Delay of game, surely.

characters.name: Roy Velvet
characters.visual: mature medium-brown man, long face, thick swept black hair with silver temples, trim black moustache
characters.biography: Roy supplies a running commentary nobody requested. His finest broadcast was interrupted by his own ball.

sayings.greeting: Good morning from the first tee!
sayings.hazard: A word from our sponsor: DATA.
sayings.slow_play: Dead air. My greatest fear.

characters.name: Cleo Clue
characters.visual: Thai adult woman age 29, beautiful pointed chin and high cheekbones, warm tan complexion, glossy chin-length black bob tucked behind one ear, intent dark eyes with subtle eyeliner, elegant arched brows, clever half-smile
characters.biography: Cleo investigates every lost ball. Her current theory involves gravity, bad judgement and a suspicious-looking squirrel.

sayings.hazard: The DATA has an alibi, apparently.
sayings.water: The trail has gone cold. And wet.
sayings.slow_play: The plot is moving very slowly.
sayings.bench: A chance to examine the seat.

characters.name: Ben Plank
characters.visual: mature pale man, broad cheekbones, wavy ginger hair, bushy ginger beard, small kind eyes
characters.biography: Ben checks every bench before sitting on it. He would check his swing too, if anybody made a spirit level long enough.

sayings.hazard: The DATA is not quite square.
sayings.water: I should have built a bridge.
sayings.slow_play: Measure twice, wait all afternoon.

characters.name: Pip Sparks
characters.visual: child with youthful round face, warm brown skin, short black springy curls, freckles, missing front tooth
characters.biography: Pip's science project asks where lost golf balls go. The lake portion of the experiment has received ample funding.

sayings.good_shot: Can I get extra credit for that?
sayings.hazard: The DATA is my control group.
sayings.slow_play: Even homework moves faster.
sayings.bench: Research can be done sitting down.

characters.name: Ada Fairway
characters.visual: Taiwanese adult woman age 27, beautiful narrow oval face, light warm skin, neat glossy black high ponytail swept behind head, almond-shaped deep brown eyes, straight brows, composed confident smile
characters.biography: Ada built a career on hitting fairways. Her sponsors wanted more drama, so she began wearing yellow socks.

sayings.greeting: Let's give accuracy a good name.
sayings.hazard: The DATA makes placement matter.
sayings.slow_play: Even patience has a time limit.
sayings.bench: Good posture starts with a rest.

characters.name: Calder Stone
characters.visual: adult pale man, heavy jaw, cropped dark hair, thick brows, crooked nose, warm grin
characters.biography: Calder can drive beyond the television towers. Finding a sensible second shot remains an ongoing collaboration.

sayings.greeting: Plenty of room out there, probably.
sayings.good_shot: That's why they insure the cameras.
sayings.hazard: The DATA is within carry range.
sayings.water: I gave that one too much ocean.
sayings.slow_play: I'd have driven there by now.

characters.name: Mina Wedge
characters.visual: Korean adult woman age 29, beautiful softly rounded face, light warm complexion, neat black chin-length bob with wispy fringe, fine brows, lively dark eyes, polished subtle makeup and mischievous smile
characters.biography: Mina once got up and down from a sponsor's flowerpot. The sponsor still sends her soil samples.

sayings.greeting: A little imagination goes a long way.
sayings.good_shot: A soft landing and a kind bounce.
sayings.hazard: The DATA offers an interesting angle.
sayings.water: Too much splash, not enough spin.
sayings.slow_play: I could practise three escapes.
sayings.bench: A little recovery for the player.

characters.name: Felix Fade
characters.visual: adult olive-skinned man, slender face, dark swept-back curls, narrow moustache, animated eyebrows
characters.biography: Felix shapes every shot, including the ones that should have been straight. His autobiography is called Around the Point.

sayings.greeting: Straight lines are only a suggestion.
sayings.good_shot: A curve with a happy ending.
sayings.hazard: Let's take the scenic side of DATA.
sayings.slow_play: This round needs a little shape.
sayings.bench: Even an artist needs a perch.

characters.name: June Putter
characters.visual: white Scottish adult woman age 35, beautiful broad smile and sculpted cheeks, fair freckled skin, copper shoulder-length waves swept back, green eyes, fashionable red glasses, poised humorous expression
characters.biography: June can read a green at forty paces. She still needs glasses to read the menu at the clubhouse.

sayings.hazard: The DATA complicates my reading.
sayings.water: That break was towards the water.
sayings.slow_play: I have read this green twice now.

characters.name: Rafael Vale
characters.visual: adult Latino man, angular tan face, long dark wavy hair tucked behind ears, trimmed beard, relaxed eyes
characters.biography: Rafael practised recovery shots in an abandoned orchard. He now feels uneasy when there is nothing between him and the flag.

sayings.greeting: Let's see what the course offers.
sayings.hazard: The DATA feels like an old friend.
sayings.water: That recovery may require a boat.
sayings.slow_play: I could grow another orchard.

characters.name: Imani Swift
characters.visual: Black American adult woman age 27, beautiful strong oval face, rich deep brown skin, black twists swept up and back, full lips, strong brows, bright dark eyes, energetic assured smile
characters.biography: Imani plays quickly, walks quickly and signs autographs quickly. Her caddie has requested a bicycle.

sayings.good_shot: That's one way to make progress.
sayings.hazard: We can be past the DATA in no time.
sayings.water: A quick dip. A slow penalty.
sayings.slow_play: Is this group in reverse?

characters.name: Otto Draw
characters.visual: mature tan man, bald crown and silver sides, square spectacles, neat grey goatee
characters.biography: Otto teaches the draw with diagrams, arrows and a small portable chalkboard. Nobody has dared ask about the fade.

sayings.greeting: Follow the plan and the ball.
sayings.hazard: The DATA requires the second diagram.
sayings.water: The diagram did not include swimming.
sayings.slow_play: We could revise the syllabus.

characters.name: Suki Gale
characters.visual: Japanese adult woman age 31, attractive broad cheekbones, warm sun-kissed tan complexion, jet black hair in compact bun with loose side strand, bright alert dark eyes, defined brows, sporty confident smile
characters.biography: Suki learned golf where the wind could move a parked trolley. She finds calm weather suspiciously underprepared.

sayings.greeting: A breeze would make this interesting.
sayings.hazard: The DATA cannot change the wind.
sayings.slow_play: Even the clouds are overtaking us.

characters.name: Bram Fortune
characters.visual: mature pale man, round face, unruly sandy curls, bushy eyebrows, gap-toothed grin
characters.biography: Bram has won three play-offs by unusual bounces. He thanks the grounds staff and a particularly cooperative drainpipe.

sayings.hazard: Perhaps the DATA owes me a favour.
sayings.water: Even luck needs a day off.
sayings.slow_play: A lucky break would be a tee time.

characters.name: Chip Hemsworth
characters.visual: fictional action actor, tan broad square face, shaggy sandy hair, thick short beard, heroic chin, friendly slightly baffled eyes
characters.biography: Chip does his own stunts and most of his own putting. His contract requires three explosions; the club has offered three bunkers.

sayings.good_shot: We'll use that in the trailer.
sayings.hazard: The DATA is my next action sequence.
sayings.slow_play: Can we cut to the next shot?

characters.name: Lady Gimme
characters.visual: fictional pop diva, pale sharp heart-shaped face, platinum sculpted bob with broad black streak, dramatic brows, amused pink lips
characters.biography: Lady Gimme changes outfits between holes and calls each lost ball a surprise release. Her caddie carries a wardrobe.

sayings.greeting: You're on the guest list, PARTNER.
sayings.hazard: The DATA needs better stage lighting.
sayings.slow_play: My encore has an encore by now.

characters.name: Morgan Foreman
characters.visual: fictional elder film narrator, deep brown skin, long kind face, short silver curls, light silver beard, calm wry eyes
characters.biography: Morgan narrates his own rounds in a reassuring voice. By the sixth hole even his penalties sound like important life lessons.

sayings.greeting: And so our round began, PARTNER.
sayings.good_shot: For a moment, the ball understood.
sayings.hazard: The DATA had other plans.
sayings.water: The lake would keep its secret.
sayings.slow_play: Time, as ever, took its time.
sayings.bench: And there, at last, was a bench.

characters.name: Meryl Sweep
characters.visual: fictional mature actress, light skin, long expressive face, high cheekbones, softly swept auburn-grey hair, knowing smile
characters.biography: Meryl spends a month researching every role. For Golfing Guest she has learned twelve accents and misplaced twelve balls.

sayings.greeting: I have prepared for this round.
sayings.hazard: What is the DATA's motivation?
sayings.water: I shall play the scene as damp.
sayings.slow_play: We seem to be between productions.

characters.name: Bruno Pars
characters.visual: fictional young singer, golden-brown skin, round face, tall glossy black pompadour, thin moustache, broad mischievous grin
characters.biography: Bruno turns every practice swing into a dance step. The club has politely asked him to stop counting the beat as strokes.

sayings.hazard: The DATA is off the beat.
sayings.slow_play: Somebody speed up the backing track.

characters.name: Dolly Par-ton
characters.visual: fictional mature country singer, warm fair skin, round rosy cheeks, enormous soft honey-blonde curls, arched brows, generous smile
characters.biography: Dolly brings spare tees for everyone and a song for every score. The triple-bogey ballad currently runs to nine verses.

sayings.greeting: Plenty of sunshine to share, honey.
sayings.good_shot: That one can sing the chorus.
sayings.hazard: We'll find a way round that DATA.
sayings.water: That ball has gone on a river tour.
sayings.slow_play: This verse is getting mighty long.

characters.name: Keanu Tees
characters.visual: fictional quiet movie actor, medium olive skin, long narrow face, shoulder-length straight dark hair, short patchy beard, gentle dark eyes
characters.biography: Keanu insists the caddie take top billing. He once spent an entire press conference discussing a particularly thoughtful bunker.

sayings.greeting: Nice to share a round, PARTNER.
sayings.good_shot: That was a good little journey.
sayings.hazard: Let's give the DATA some space.
sayings.water: The ball chose a different path.
sayings.slow_play: No rush. Perhaps a little movement.
sayings.bench: This is quite an excellent bench.

characters.name: Opal Windfree
characters.visual: fictional mature talk-show host, deep brown skin, full rounded face, voluminous dark curls, warm wide-set eyes, bold rounded spectacles
characters.biography: Opal interviews her playing partners between shots. Everyone leaves with a new tee, a heartfelt insight and a slightly longer round.

sayings.hazard: Tell me how the DATA makes you feel.
sayings.slow_play: Let's bring out our next golfer.

characters.name: Gordon Ramslice
characters.visual: fictional middle-aged television chef, pale flushed skin, deeply lined square face, upright untidy sandy hair, sharp blue eyes, comic exasperation
characters.biography: Gordon judges fairways for presentation and greens for consistency. He has sent his own scorecard back to the kitchen twice.

sayings.greeting: Right. Let's serve up a round.
sayings.hazard: Who plated that DATA there?
sayings.slow_play: This service is glacial.
sayings.bench: Even this bench is better rested.

characters.name: Serena Volley
characters.visual: fictional adult champion athlete, rich dark brown skin, strong oval face, thick black hair in high braided bun, confident broad smile
characters.biography: Serena has power, precision and an excellent overhead smash. The professional has asked her to stop using the third one on the greens.

sayings.greeting: Your serve. I mean, your honour.
sayings.hazard: The DATA is playing the net.
sayings.water: That ball is out by quite a lot.
sayings.slow_play: Are we waiting for a line judge?
sayings.bench: A change of ends for my feet.
